rationale: Splitting pulp-format into an authoring half and a view-coupled half touches test/cmake/view_widget_bridge_tests.cmake for one reason: that file registers the inspect_runtime_eval_archive_check site, which scans base archives for the runtime-eval marker. The split leaves the pulp-format umbrella holding only a placeholder object, so the existing scan would have passed while inspecting nothing; the change repoints it at pulp-format-core and pulp-format-view and adds a positive control so a code-free archive fails loudly. It registers two new tests in that manifest's sibling format manifest and adds no visual-proof, screenshot, golden-image, capture, or harness behaviour of any kind, and changes no existing visual-proof assertion, fixture, or baseline. Vellum source authority is unaffected.
tests: pulp-inspect-runtime-eval-archive-boundary, proven red on a code-free archive and on a genuine marker leak, and green on real archives
format-header-view-boundary, proven red four ways and green when restored
full ctest, 21093 of 21095 passing with both failures reproduced on pristine origin/main
